classes/arcane-archer-378.name: Arcane Archer
classes/arcane-archer-378.proficiencyText: An arcane archer is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields.

proficiencyReview.note: Exact Dungeon Master's Guide v.3.5 training grant verified against the class feature text.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Every nonmagical arrow the arcane archer nocks and fires becomes magical for her, gaining a +1 enhancement bonus at 1st level. The bonus improves to +2 at 3rd level, +3 at 5th, +4 at 7th, and +5 at 9th; these arrows function as enhanced arrows only for the arcane archer.

levelGrants.name: Imbue Arrow
levelGrants.description: Place an area spell upon an arrow and fire it as part of the same standard action. The spell's area is centered where the arrow lands, allowing the bow's range to replace the spell's normal range; the arrow must be fired in the round the spell is cast or the spell is wasted.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +2 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Seeker Arrow
levelGrants.description: Once per day as a standard action, launch an arrow at a known target within range. The arrow can travel around corners and ignores cover and concealment modifiers, though an unavoidable obstacle or the limit of the arrow's range stops it; otherwise resolve the attack normally.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +3 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Phase Arrow
levelGrants.description: Once per day as a standard action, launch an arrow in a straight path at a known target within range. It passes through nonmagical barriers and ignores cover, concealment, and armor modifiers; magical barriers such as wall of force or wall of fire still stop it, and the attack is otherwise resolved normally.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +4 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Hail of Arrows
levelGrants.description: Once per day in place of regular attacks, fire one arrow at each target within range, up to one target per arcane archer class level. Each attack uses the archer's primary attack bonus, and each enemy can be targeted by only one arrow.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +5 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Arrow of Death
levelGrants.description: Create an arrow of death in one day. A creature damaged by it must succeed on a DC 20 Fortitude save or be slain immediately. The arrow functions only for its creator, lasts no longer than one year, and the arcane archer can have only one arrow of death in existence at a time.

classes/dwarven-defender-385.name: Dwarven Defender
classes/dwarven-defender-385.proficiencyText: A dwarven defender is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.

proficiencyReview.note: Exact Dungeon Master's Guide v.3.5 training grant verified against the class feature text.

defensiveStance.movementRestriction: cannot move from the defended spot until Mobile Defense

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: Gain a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class at 1st level. The class AC bonus improves to +2 at 4th level, +3 at 7th level, and +4 at 10th level.

levelGrants.name: Defensive Stance
levelGrants.description: Enter a defensive stance during your own action, gaining +2 Strength, +4 Constitution, +2 resistance on all saves, and +4 dodge AC while unable to leave the defended spot. The Constitution increase adds 2 hit points per character level while the stance lasts. The stance lasts 3 + the improved Constitution modifier rounds and can be ended early; when it ends, you are winded and take -2 Strength for the rest of the encounter. Daily uses increase from 1/day at 1st level to 2/day at 3rd, 3/day at 5th, 4/day at 7th, and 5/day at 9th.

levelGrants.name: Uncanny Dodge
levelGrants.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC when flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. If another class already grants uncanny dodge, the combined interaction grants improved uncanny dodge instead.

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: The class dodge bonus to Armor Class improves to +2.

levelGrants.name: Trap Sense
levelGrants.description: Gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps and +1 dodge AC against trap attacks. Both bonuses improve to +2 at 8th level and stack with trap sense bonuses from other classes.

levelGrants.name: Damage Reduction
levelGrants.description: Gain damage reduction 3/-. At 10th level this improves to 6/-. Damage reduction can reduce damage to 0 but not below 0.

levelGrants.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
levelGrants.description: You can no longer be flanked except by a rogue at least four levels higher than your effective level for this ability. Levels from classes granting uncanny dodge stack to determine that effective level.

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: The class dodge bonus to Armor Class improves to +3.

levelGrants.name: Mobile Defense
levelGrants.description: While maintaining Defensive Stance, take one 5-foot step each round without losing the stance's benefits.

levelGrants.name: Trap Sense
levelGrants.description: Trap Sense improves to +2 on Reflex saves against traps and +2 dodge AC against trap attacks.

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: The class dodge bonus to Armor Class improves to +4.

levelGrants.name: Damage Reduction
levelGrants.description: Damage Reduction improves to 6/-.
